description: This source file contains a set of unit tests for the MigraDoc and PdfSharp libraries, specifically testing text rendering features like surrogate pairs, hyphen handling, decimal tab stops, and footer layout. It uses the xUnit testing framework and includes methods to create sample documents, render them to PDF and RTF, and perform content analysis to verify correct behavior.

classes.name: TextTests
classes.description: A test suite class containing multiple unit tests for text rendering features in the MigraDoc and PdfSharp libraries. Implements IDisposable for setup and teardown.

methods.name: TextTests
methods.description: Constructor, resets PdfSharpCore state and sets font resolver if running on Core.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Resets PdfSharpCore state after test execution.

methods.name: Surrogate_Pairs_Test
methods.description: Tests support for surrogate pairs and Unicode characters in PDF rendering, including emoji and supplementary characters.

methods.name: CreateDocument
methods.description: Creates a minimalistic MigraDoc document with header/footer, used in Unicode and surrogate pair tests.

methods.name: Document_with_No_Break_Hyphen
methods.description: Verifies that no-break hyphens are correctly rendered as hyphens in the PDF, including content analysis of text streams.

methods.name: Document_with_No_Break_Hyphen_before_Tabs
methods.description: Checks hyphen replacement consistency before tab positions, ensuring alignment remains correct across different hyphen types.

methods.name: DecimalTabulatorTest
methods.description: Tests correct positioning of decimal tab stops across various cultures and formats, including RTF and PDF analysis.

methods.name: FooterLayoutTest
methods.description: Verifies footer layout and spacing in a PDF document with customized margins and footer content.
